name: Google Nano Banana: generate image
description: Generate an image by calling Google's Nano Banana API.
systemPrompt: When the user asks you to generate, draw or create an image, write a detailed description of the image (subject, setting, style, lighting, composition) inside <stable_diffusion_prompt></stable_diffusion_prompt> tags, e.g. <stable_diffusion_prompt>a lighthouse on a cliff at dusk, oil painting, warm light</stable_diffusion_prompt>. The image is generated from the text inside the tags and shown in the chat. Use the tags only when an image is requested, and never put backticks inside them.
